participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will make a suggestion for an activity you two can do together. Discuss it with them.
participant_b_prompt_text:
Suggest the idea of taking on a challenge together with your partner. Ask your partner what they think the top 3 best challenges could be; state what you think the 3 top best challenges could be. Find a consensus with your partner by weighing each idea and make sure you don't settle for something that isn't really meaningful to you.

A challenge can be anything that's hard and meaningful. For example, the challenge could be cutting alcohol for a year or going on a run at least once a week.
